content_of_post_to_answer: Do you find it easier to focus when you are in a room with a closed door?
answer: Yes, because a closed door does more than block noise; it removes the subtle feeling that you might be interrupted. An open door keeps part of your attention available to the outside world, even when nobody enters. I've explored this connection between environment and attention in more detail on my profile, if you're interested. Sometimes focus improves not because we try harder, but because we stop having to remain available.
